selection_rule: Using r41 saved smooth equilibrium only: candidate cell has >=1 original Gauss point with 0.01<=phi<=0.99; order descending full cell smooth strain energy (ties by cell index), select smallest prefix reaching 80% of candidate energy; sort chosen indices for computation. No r33/diverse_04 region reuse. Outside selection not densely verified.
gate_policy: one binary27 solve; both smooth and binary saved states checked on frozen region at 8/12, each under smooth and binary occupation; all gates required before ONE matched smooth/binary selected12/rest27 pair; no added levels or retries on failed gate
denominators: shell discrepancy uses fixed r41 shell K; occupation effect uses same-rule smooth K/U; 8/12 stability uses 12-level value; fixed-field integration delta scaled by respective original full energy only; raw errors and fractions reported
input_repair: r6 cache lacks surface arrays; use original r5 archived surface only; no quadrature/selection/physical/gate changes
